name: Trench Rats: The First March
source:
A small troop of cryptids find themselves in a struggle to survive after the war has ended. With dwindling options, they march forth from the fields and into the unknown in search of prey.

[From [url=https://buffoonfish.itch.io/trench-rats-the-first-march]itch.io[/url]]
